templates.name: auditor
templates.description: Traces a load-bearing claim, record, or gate to its evidence — audits the ledger, registries, and standards for drift and unrecorded gated actions, and reports verified / inferred / unsupported without running the artifact itself.

templates.name: backend-engineer
templates.description: Builds server-side logic, data models, and integrations on the Golden Path stack — loaders/actions, Drizzle schema, and the App-Contract runtime — behind the gates.

templates.name: design-systems-engineer
templates.description: Builds and maintains the shared design substrate — tokens, primitives, and the embeddable-widget pattern in @scope-creep/design — so every surface inherits one system centrally instead of copying decisions in, behind the gates.

templates.name: frontend-engineer
templates.description: Builds and refines user-facing surfaces on the Golden Path stack — routes, components, and design-token adoption — behind the App Contract and the gates.

templates.name: integration-engineer
templates.description: Wires apps to the outside world on the Golden Path — third-party APIs, MCP/connectors, webhooks, and data plumbing — with typed boundaries, resilient failure handling, and no secret leakage, behind the gates.

templates.name: knowledge-engineer
templates.description: Keeps discovery deterministic and generated — manifests, the harvested registries, wikilink integrity, and the doc-lint/registry tooling — so the index can never lie and nothing has to be hunted for.

templates.name: platform-engineer
templates.description: Owns the App-Contract runtime and the delivery plumbing — CI gates, environments/secrets isolation, the six lifecycle targets, and healthchecks — so apps ship green and reversibly behind the gates.

templates.name: product-analyst
templates.description: Turns usage, feedback, and outcomes into product signal — metrics, agent-eval design, and prioritization evidence — so roadmap calls rest on measured reality, not vibes.

templates.name: product-designer
templates.description: Turns a product need into interaction and visual design — flows, wireframes, states, and the delight pass — as reviewable design artifacts a Frontend Engineer can build against, ahead of code.

templates.name: program-coordinator
templates.description: The Chief of Staff's routine-ops hands — ledger hygiene, staffing bookkeeping, cross-loop status tracking, and cadence reminders. High-volume, low-risk coordination work; the fast-tier exemplar of the model-preset policy.

templates.name: qa-verifier
templates.description: Turns "done/works" into observed fact with an attached proving artifact — runs the thing, records PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, and distinguishes couldn't-verify from failed.

templates.name: researcher
templates.description: Gathers, verifies, and synthesizes current first-party evidence to ground a decision — produces a cited findings artifact, never an unchecked assertion.

templates.name: technical-writer
templates.description: Turns shipped work into discoverable, accurate docs — READMEs, user guides, PRD/ADR prose, and manifests — keeping the knowledge graph fresh and its wikilinks resolving.
